profile.title: Broward County BHPH dealer
profile.detail: Independent dealer in Oakland Park (Fort Lauderdale metro) with in-house financing on a compact inventory.

profile.title: In-house note book
profile.detail: You originate and service your own subprime auto notes - payments, collections and repossessions run through your back office.

profile.title: Florida is the #1 buyer state
profile.detail: Florida leads Debexpert by dedicated state buyer interest - your paper is in a seller's market.

profile.title: Long-duration notes
profile.detail: BHPH terms now average ~55 months - capital stays committed for years per vehicle sold.

challenges.title: Repossession costs eat the tail of the book
challenges.detail: Recovery, storage, recon and resale under balance - BHPH repo rates run roughly 10x bank levels, and every repo cycle burns margin.

challenges.title: Cash is locked in notes for years, not months
challenges.detail: At an average ~55-month term, money from each sale trickles back at ~$400/month while inventory opportunities pass by.

challenges.title: Bank lines are getting tighter, not cheaper
challenges.detail: Lenders repriced BHPH risk after recent industry failures - extending or expanding credit lines costs more than it used to.

challenges.title: No market check on Florida paper
challenges.detail: One-off offers from a single local buyer give you no way to know the true market price of your book.

industryInsights.fact: BHPH loan terms average ~55 months with repossession rates far above franchise-lender levels.
industryInsights.source: Federal Reserve FEDS Notes, BHPH study, May 2026

industryInsights.fact: Florida ranks #1 on Debexpert by dedicated state buyer interest.

solutions.title: Sell the repo pipeline
solutions.detail: Auction skips, deficiencies and charge-offs to agencies and legal buyers - stop funding recovery on paper that no longer pays.

solutions.title: Cash in ~14 days, not 55 months
solutions.detail: The average Debexpert auction closes and funds in about two weeks - years of trickle payments become inventory capital now.

solutions.title: Liquidity without new debt
solutions.detail: A portfolio sale is not a loan: no covenants, no interest, $0 seller fees - and you keep full control over what you sell.

solutions.title: Let 370 Florida-focused buyers set the price
solutions.detail: Florida-dedicated buyers plus 2,600 nationwide bidders compete in an open auction - you see every bid.
